literal_meaning: দিনগুলো কাটানো বা অতিবাহিত করা (days passing or being spent)
figurative_meaning_en: to pass or spend time (often implying hardship or routine)
example_sentences_in_bangla: বাড়িতে বসে দিন কাটানোর চেষ্টা করছি।
example_sentences_in_english: The days are passing in hardship.
I'm trying to pass the time sitting at home.
note: This idiom often conveys a sense of enduring daily challenges in Bengali culture.
